description: Canonical tropical cyclone target and threshold manifest defining track, intensity, rapid intensification, landfall location, landfall timing, and conformal track uncertainty failure modes.

invariants.temporal_safety: Cyclone verification targets are evaluated post-valid-time against authoritative best-track data (IMD / RSMC New Delhi / JTWC) sealed behind verification latency.
invariants.feature_target_isolation: No best-track observations, post-valid-time fixes, or ground-truth residuals may enter issue-time feature sets.
invariants.decomposed_not_opaque: Cyclone reliability must be decomposed into track, intensity, rapid intensification, landfall timing, and landfall location; never collapsed into a single opaque score.
invariants.unsupported_quantities_null: Landfall timing and location outputs evaluate to null when the cyclone is not forecast to make landfall or coastal distance is unsupported.

targets.description: Track position error exceedance: Great-circle distance between forecast center and verified best-track center exceeds operational tolerance.
Intensity error exceedance: Absolute error in maximum sustained wind speed exceeds 15 knots (7.7 m/s).

modes.FALSE_ALARM: Forecast Delta_V24 >= 15.4 m/s AND Observed Delta_V24 < 15.4 m/s
modes.MISS: Forecast Delta_V24 < 15.4 m/s AND Observed Delta_V24 >= 15.4 m/s

targets.formula: (FC_RI AND NOT OBS_RI) OR (NOT FC_RI AND OBS_RI)
targets.description: Rapid Intensification (RI) failure: Binary failure to predict an intensification rate >= 30 kt (15.4 m/s) in 24 hours, or false alarm.
Landfall location displacement: Distance along the coastline between forecast and actual landfall points exceeds 80 km. Null if non-landfall.
Landfall timing displacement: Difference between forecast and observed landfall time exceeds 6 hours. Null if non-landfall.
Conformal track uncertainty region: Calibrated spatial radius guaranteeing 80% and 90% empirical coverage on held-out cycles.
